title: Regular-pullback transition comparison over base codimension at most one
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$. Let $r:P\to X$ be a regular morphism between Noetherian excellent schemes [def-exc-excellent-ring]; regular means flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] with fibres that remain regular after every finite residue-field extension [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Assume $\ell$ is invertible. Let $\delta_X$ be a dimension function and $(K,(p_x))$ a pinned potential dualizing complex [def-per-potential-dualizing]. Define maps $p^r_t$ as follows. For $x=r(t)$ localize $X$ at $x$, write $i:P_x\hookrightarrow P\times_X\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}$ for the closed fibre and $q:P_x\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)$, and use [lem-per-regular-closed-support-base-change] to identify $i^!r^*K$ with $q^*R\Gamma_xK$. Apply $q^*p_x$, then on the regular fibre use the inverse absolute-purity class at $t$ [lem-per-regular-gysin-calculus]. Thus
$$p^r_t:C_t(r^*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda(\delta_X(r(t))-b(t))[2\delta_X(r(t))-2b(t)],\qquad b(t)=\dim\mathcal O_{P_{r(t)},t}.$$
For every geometric specialization $t'\rightsquigarrow t$ over $x'\rightsquigarrow x$ such that $c_X(x',x)\leq1$, these maps identify the generalized transition of [lem-per-general-costalk-transitions] with the identity of the correspondingly twisted copy of $\Lambda$. Explicitly, with $c=c_P(t',t)$, the maps on cohomology satisfy
$$H^i(p^r_{t'})=H^{i+2c}(p^r_t(c))\circ\operatorname{sp}^{i}_{t',t}.$$
Targets are identified by $\delta_X(x')-b(t')=\delta_X(x)-b(t)+c$. No restriction is placed on $c_P(t',t)$, and the assertion is only for base codimension zero or one, not for arbitrary base specializations.
